name: Atarfe (Spain)
description: White field with a thin green border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Atarfe (a tower and a pomegranate on blue).
history: Atarfe has arms adopted officially on 9 December 1976 and uses its own flag, although it has not yet been approved under the regional regulations; the ensign is white with a thin green edge all round.

features.role: Atarfe arms — tower and pomegranate on blue
